title: Masu Sauraro Ɓoyayye Waɗanda Suka Yi Imani
intro: A cikin shiru na wani taro mai tsarki, wani taro mai ban mamaki ya fito daga wani yanki da ba a gani. Sun jawo hankalin su da raɗa na wani abu mai ban mamaki, suka saurari karatun da zai rufe makomarsu har abada. Shaidarsu ta kasance ɗaya daga cikin mafi ban mamaki a cikin nassosin Allah.
clues: Mu halittu ne daga wani yanki da yawancin mutane ba su gani ba, kuma mun zo ne a matsayin ƙungiya.
Mun yi tafiya zuwa wani taro domin jin wani abu mai ban mamaki.
Da muka isa, muka saurari wani karatu da ya ba mu mamaki.
Mun bayyana a fili cewa wasu daga cikinmu masu adalci ne wasu kuma ba sa yin hakan.
Mun san ba za mu iya tserewa daga hukuncin Allah a duniya ba, ko kuma ta hanyar guduwa zuwa sama.
Da muka ji shiriya, muka yi imani da ita; duk wanda ya yi imani da Ubangijinsa ba zai ji tsoron asara ko nauyi ba.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana halaka mu saboda kisan annabawanmu

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Kogo mai tsarki a cikin tsaunuka

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Mun yi imani kuma mun yi gargaɗi ga mutanenmu
An halaka ta da wata babbar iska daga sama
An hukunta shi da iska mai zafi da halaka
An ba shi dukiya da iko mai yawa
Ya kasance mai tsayin daka cikin rashin imani
outcome.answer: Mun yi imani kuma mun yi gargaɗi ga mutanenmu

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
